title: control.command payload v2
description: A single structured instruction sent from the Control Plane to an Agent. Supersedes v1's separate deploy_command/instance_command payloads with one generic envelope whose `type` selects the command — see the closed AgentCommandType enum. There is no shell/free-form command message anywhere in this protocol.

command_id.description: Primary key of the agent_commands row this corresponds to.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied or generated key; resubmitting the same key returns the original command instead of creating a duplicate.

payload.description: Command-type-specific structured fields. Never a shell command string.

expires_at.description: If no terminal event arrives before this, the Control Plane marks the command timed_out.

correlation_id.description: Optional id of the deployment/instance/etc. that triggered this command, for cross-referencing.
